notes: Owner annotations identify data-center buildings 1, 2 and 3. The owner confirmed on 9 September 2026 that these are Buildings A, B and C respectively — east, middle and west. The traced footprints rank in the same order as the owner-reported areas (1,500 / 2,083 / 3,535 sq ft), which corroborates the mapping but does not measure it.
Annotated factory rectangles are not drawn to the written dimensions. This model honors 200 × 150 ft and uses approximate positions.
All heights are display assumptions. Site massing is not photogrammetry or architectural design.
11,000 sq ft former-greenhouse concrete pad is intentionally omitted from proposed layers per owner request. Original survey still shows its historical depiction.
No solar yield, panel count or BESS runtime is inferred.
